docs.title: Quantum API Unreal Plugin
docs.description: Beginner-friendly Blueprint docs for the QuantumApi Unreal Engine runtime plugin.
docs.summary: QuantumApi is a UE 5.8 Runtime plugin that gives Blueprints asynchronous nodes for Quantum API requests. Use it to call simulations, random helpers, QASM tools, and hardware jobs without blocking the game thread.

docs.title: Quantum API TypeScript SDK
docs.description: Beginner-friendly TypeScript and Node.js docs for @mr.dj2u/quantum-api.
docs.summary: The TypeScript SDK is a package-ready Node.js client for the Quantum API. It normalizes the mounted API address for you and provides typed methods for runtime calls, account setup, IBM profiles, and jobs.

docs.title: Quantum API Python SDK
docs.description: Beginner-friendly Python docs for the quantum-api-sdk synchronous client.
docs.summary: The Python SDK is a synchronous, package-ready client for scripts, CLIs, services, and backend automation. It handles the Quantum API's mounted /v1 address and returns structured errors when a request fails.

resourceLinks.label: SDK source
resourceLinks.description: Python SDK source in the Quantum API repository.

docs.title: Quantum API Godot Addon
docs.description: Beginner-friendly Godot 4 runtime addon docs for Quantum API gameplay calls.
docs.summary: The Godot addon is a runtime client you add to a Godot project. It provides health checks, text transforms, gate runs, backend discovery, transpile, and IBM circuit-job calls without becoming editor tooling.

docs.title: Quantum API Unity Package
docs.description: Beginner-friendly Unity runtime package docs for Quantum API gameplay calls.
docs.summary: The Unity package is a runtime helper for gameplay code. It uses UnityWebRequest behind coroutine and Task entry points, normalizes the Quantum API address, and starts with health, gate, and text-transform calls.
